sources.title: Solar power to rule in 20 years, futurists say

sourceCaveat: Claims are shown as paraphrases unless identified as a verified quotation.

reference.criterion: Solar energy actually supplies global energy demand, not merely enough theoretical sunshine or nameplate power.
reference.rationale: The 2028 deadline remains in the future. IEA reports solar supplied over 8% of global electricity in 2025—substantial growth, but electricity is only part of energy and far from all energy.

evidence.title: IEA: Global Energy Review 2026, global trends
evidence.note: 2025 solar PV generation nearly 2,700 TWh, over 8% of electricity. Growth contribution does not mean share of all energy.. 2025 solar PV generation nearly 2,700 TWh, over 8% of electricity. Growth contribution does not mean share of all energy.
